flags: The cache supports scenery and state-byway status but supplies no byway designation date, road-building history or campaign. Regional transportation history substitutes for the missing road history without equating the old railroad with the byway.

Travel Iowa describes a 144-mile network, while material maps 93.1 miles. The selected sequence follows Lansing (24.44) then Waukon (40.57), with the Harpers Ferry/Effigy Mounds excursion before the Postville end. No complete 144-mile turn-by-turn geometry or drive time is established.

Lansing cache/01.txt reports the Black Hawk Bridge demolished December 20, 2025, but retains stale text describing highway access over it. No replacement opening or current crossing status is established. The story does not recommend crossing it.
No current story claims were dropped for lack of cache support. The broad tagline about glaciers was narrowed to the last glaciation; older glacial deposits are documented in cache/29.txt.
Effigy Mounds cultural associations are supported by a secondary account quoting NPS; no tribal primary page is cached. No ceremonies or unrestricted site access are promised.
